title: Serpent of Eden
description: A surreal scene depicts a giant blue and green serpent spiraling through a rainbow sky above an ancient yellow courtyard with palm trees and classical architecture. In the foreground, a bearded man in blue robes stands in a tiled pool holding the serpent's tail, while a three-faced winged angel stands on a pink lily pad, a large green frog with red eyes sits on another, and two small grey aliens interact with the water.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal painting of a massive blue and green scaled serpent spiraling down from a rainbow sky into an ancient yellow stone courtyard with palm trees. A bearded man in blue robes stands in a tiled pool reaching up to touch the serpent's tail. A three-faced winged female angel in a white dress stands on a giant pink lily pad. A large bright green frog with red eyes sits on another lily pad. Two small grey aliens stand in the shallow water holding small objects. Classical architecture in the background, vibrant colors, mystical atmosphere.
